failure_modes.what: stopsSave issues atCreateBatch, then atPatchBatch, then N separate atDelete calls as three independent HTTP round-trips with no transaction; if the order (submitIntlOrder) succeeded but stopsSave's create batch fails partway, the order exists with zero or partial stops
failure_modes.gap: no check counts 'order created in the last N minutes with zero order_stops rows' as its own signal — 02a proposes this as a NEW pairing (AL orders→AL order_stops ≤10s) but it is not in the 37 installed checks (02b §Σύνοψη: nothing runs on a schedule today)

failure_modes.what: each of the 8 cascade steps after step 0 is wrapped in its own try/catch + console.warn and increments _delFail on error; the toast only says 'N linked records failed — δες error log', never which N or which table
failure_modes.visibility: loud (toast) but content is not actionable
failure_modes.gap: no audit trail records WHICH sub-step failed beyond the generic 'Cascade delete: N sub-deletes failed' logError call — a dispatcher cannot act on the message

failure_modes.what: the DB RPC and the front-end's own manual steps 1/2/3/5 (NAT_LOADS, GL/CL, RAMP, ORDER_STOPS) both attempt to remove the same linked rows for the same order — the RPC runs first as a side effect of step 0's DELETE, then the front end re-attempts deletes on rows that may already be gone
failure_modes.gap: a second delete of an already-cascade-deleted NL/CL/stop either 404s (counted as _delFail, inflating the toast's failure count for what is actually correct behaviour) or succeeds as a no-op soft-delete-of-already-deleted row — neither path is distinguished from a real cascade failure; genuinely NOT covered by the RPC (confirmed by 023's own comment): rtOnOrderDeleted (RT legs) and PARTNER_ASSIGN deletion, which the front end still must do

failure_modes.what: cancelOrder calls syncOrderDownstream with changedFields:['Status'] only; PL feed sync and rtOnOrderSaved (order-sync.js step 5) only run when changedFields includes 'Pallet Exchange', so a cancelled order's round trip is never cancelled and never warned about from this path
failure_modes.gap: no check for 'Cancelled order with a still-active ct_round_trips leg' exists in the 37 installed checks (02a proposes it as NEW Β-40, not yet built)

failure_modes.what: the card's status-change button can set Status='Delivered' without going through _opsDelFinal — it never writes Actual Delivery Date, Delivery Performance, or calls plOnDelivered/pallet-ledger sync; a second, cheaper 'door' to the same state as F-26 exists
failure_modes.gap: check:B-19 (delivered_stop_no_stamp) catches it the NEXT morning at earliest, not at write time

failure_modes.what: clearing an assignment (Truck/Partner → empty, Status → Pending) does not call rtOnOrderSaved — the round trip created by the DB trigger (rt_create_from_order) for the now-unassigned order is left pointing at a vehicle-less order
failure_modes.gap: B-06 (rt_vehicle_drift) only fires once the DB and the order actually disagree on truck_id/driver_id — an RT that still shows the OLD vehicle while the order shows none is not flagged unless something else also changes it

failure_modes.what: 'Matched Import ID' is a plain text scalar column (confirmed worker/src/index.js:1204), not an FK — a match with no corresponding round trip is possible and the warning toast ('P&L: απέτυχε...') disappears after 8s; only the owner sees TRIP PnL to notice
failure_modes.gap: 02a proposes NEW Β-44 'matched_import_id χωρίς σκέλος RT' — not among the 37 installed checks
